The '''BAW E-5s sniper rifle''' was a four-shot [[Sniper rifle/Legends|rifle]] produced by [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]]<ref name="BF I guide" /> and used by the [[Battle droid assassin]]s of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]].<ref name="BF I" /> When the rogue [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Gizor Dellso]] reactivated an [[Gizor Dellso's army|army]], the sniper rifle was used by his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="BF II" />

Unlike its [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] counterpart, the [[DC-15x sniper rifle/Legends|DC-15x sniper rifle]], the E-5s had additional magnification levels but suffered from a smaller magazine size.<ref name="BF I">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref>
